verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers API integration, webhooks, chargebacks, guarantees, and pricing pages, but contains no mention of a score breakdown, risk factors, feature explanations, or any transparency into why a decision/score was made — no reference to explainability, contributing factors, or reason codes accompanying the Get Decision response. Missing for 10: documentation of risk factor fields in decision responses, examples of factor-level explanations, any model-transparency or explainability feature.
